149811.rationale: North Macedonia's government declared a nationwide 30-day state of crisis over wildfires on 9 Jul 2025 (and on 5 Aug 2021), and it already had dozens of fires in June 2026 amid a record European heatwave. Greece and Spain usually declare regional emergencies only, which do not count.
149811.next_info: Daily during Jul 1-25 2026: North Macedonia govt sessions/Crisis Management Center, Greek civil protection, Portugal 'situacao de alerta/contingencia', EU Civil Protection Mechanism activations.

683823.rationale: In June 2026 the Danube was at 30-50% of normal flow (Baziaș 2,600-3,600 m3/s, forecast 2,700). Greenpeace has warned that Cernavoda's cooling water could be cut off, and Cernavoda's procedures call for shutting the units one by one as the water level falls (the 2003 precedent). Cernavoda is Romania's only NPP.
683823.next_info: INHGA weekly Danube forecasts; Nuclearelectrica/Energy Ministry statements in July; a Danube flow below ~2,000 m3/s would be the trigger (late Jul).

772343.rationale: The wording ('shutdown of the last operating reactor') fits Cernavoda's two CANDU units being shut down in sequence as the Danube falls during the 2026 drought. Other single-plant countries are much less exposed.
772343.next_info: Nuclearelectrica stock-exchange notices and Danube levels at Cernavoda, Aug 1-13 2026.

604201.rationale: The sanctioned Cameroon-flagged Suezmax Caroline Bezengi (IMO 9224439) hit a mine around 6-11 Jun 2026 at the eastern exit of the Gulf of Aden. It was last seen not under command, moving slowly off Yemen. Where it ran aground is unknown (possibly Socotra or another island, given the islands exclusion). Yemen's mainland is the closest and most likely to be hit; Somalia (Puntland) and Oman are the alternatives depending on monsoon drift.
604201.next_info: Reports from Yemen EPA, Puntland or Oman MECA and EUNAVFOR on where the slick comes ashore, Jul-Aug 13 2026.

446236.rationale: Bavi is the 9th name of 2026 (Mekkhala was No.7 and Higos No.8, formed 23 Jun near Saipan), so Bavi was expected to form around 25-30 Jun. In this El Nino year storms are forming far east, which favours tracks toward East China. Zhejiang and Fujian evacuate very large numbers; Guangdong does too when it is in the path.
446236.next_info: CMA/NMC Bavi track forecasts once it is named (late Jun-early Jul); provincial evacuation tallies from Xinhua/CCTV by Jul 11.

66613.rationale: Based on July landfall climatology, shifted toward East China because 2026 is an El Nino year and storms are forming far east. No Bavi track was available as of 24 Jun.
66613.next_info: NMC track forecasts after Bavi forms (~late Jun/early Jul); landfall report by Jul 11.

442417.rationale: Noul is the 12th name, likely forming mid-July. Forecast is mid/late-July climatology for mainland landfalls, adjusted slightly toward East China for El Nino.
442417.next_info: Noul formation and NMC forecasts (mid-Jul); landfall report by Jul 21.

737715.rationale: Dolphin (13th name) became a typhoon over the Pacific in late July. Landfalls of Pacific-origin typhoons in early August cluster in Zhejiang and Fujian (Wenling, Putian Xiuyu, Jinjiang, Fuqing), with Guangdong (Taishan) next. Probability is spread very thin across many possible cities.
737715.next_info: NMC track forecasts for Dolphin, late Jul-early Aug; CMA landfall bulletin naming the city (by Aug 8).

872064.rationale: Himachal Pradesh topped July tolls in 2023 and 2025 and its SDMA publishes cumulative counts that news outlets widely cite. One-off disasters made Kerala (2024 Wayanad) and Maharashtra (2021 Raigad) the leaders in other years. The 2026 monsoon arrived about 9 days late in central India (El Nino year).
872064.next_info: State SDMA cumulative tolls (HP SDMA daily), reports of major cloudbursts or landslides, Jul 1-Aug 5.

764544.rationale: The deadliest Indonesian quake of 2026 found so far is the 16 Jun M6.7 Sigi/Palu quake in Central Sulawesi (3 deaths per BNPB). The 2 Apr M7.4-7.6 Molucca Sea quake killed 1 in Manado. Only about an 8-week window remains for a deadlier quake (base rate ~15-25%).
764544.next_info: BNPB reports of any deadly quake before Aug 17; any revision of the Sigi toll.

205592.rationale: May 2026 FFPI: sugar +7.5% (El Nino worries for India and Thailand, Brazil diverting cane to ethanol), cereals +2.6%, meat +0.1%, dairy -0.5%, vegetable oils -4.6%. Sugar or vegetable oils usually post the largest August gain. Indonesia's B50 biodiesel mandate (from 1 Jul) and El Nino lift palm oil, while the northern-hemisphere harvest tends to weigh on cereals in August.
205592.next_info: FAO FFPI releases on Jul 3 (June data), Aug 7 (July data), Sep 4 (August data); ICE sugar, palm oil (BMD) and CBOT moves in August.

224345.rationale: SIIA issued a red haze alert on 24 Jun 2026, with a strong El Nino and positive IOD expected and the peak seen in Aug-Sep. Riau already declared an emergency alert on 13 Feb (valid to 30 Nov). Indonesian provinces commonly declare emergency status. Malaysia declares area emergencies when API exceeds 500 (1997, 2005, 2013).
224345.next_info: ASMC hotspot counts and alert levels, Indonesian BNPB/provincial status changes, Malaysian API readings, Aug-Sep 5.

490094.rationale: Bundibugyo outbreak (declared 15 May): 896 confirmed and 232 deaths by 17 Jun, about 91% of them in Ituri. WHO flagged North Kivu (Katwa, Butembo, Beni; 58 of its 62 cases in the last 21 days) as showing 'increasing transmission activity'. By mid-September a surge is most plausible in North Kivu, with Ituri still a contender.
490094.next_info: WHO AFRO weekly sitreps and DONs (Jul-Sep), with attention to provincial trends; WHO statements Sep 10-16.

565579.rationale: In Q1 2026 (+0.5% q/q), net exports added +0.3pp and domestic demand +0.2pp. Q2 growth is forecast near zero. Hormuz-related oil import cuts could raise net exports while stockpile releases subtract from domestic demand (JRI), although ING expects net exports to drag. 'Top-level' most likely means domestic versus external demand.
565579.next_info: May-June trade data (Jun 17/Jul 16 releases), consumption activity index, economists' Q2 previews (early Aug); release Aug 17 08:50 JST.
